scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec app npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
